candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeout as deepest error, but no redis-side metrics/logs confirm whether cause is redis saturation, network, or pool exhaustion.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with ~2s transport ReadTimeouts on order->inventory calls; traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from inventory and 502 from order to gateway. Redis timeout is the best-supported bounded candidate.
